blocks.label: Overview
bullets: Omega-3 Fatty Acids Are Integral Parts of Cell Membranes
paragraphs: Fish is commonly recommended as part of a heart-healthy diet thanks to its many benefits. But if fish isn’t routinely on your plate, a supplement can help fill this gap. Swanson Omega-3 Fish Oil softgels deliver 180 mg EPA and 120 mg DHA per serving with a fresh lemon flavor.

blocks.label: Suggested use
paragraphs: As a dietary supplement, take one softgel two times per day with water, during meals.

blocks.label: Other ingredients
paragraphs: Softgel (gelatin, glycerin, purified water), natural lemon oil, mixed tocopherols (vitamin e).

blocks.label: Warnings
paragraphs: For adults only. Consult your healthcare provider before using this or any product if you are pregnant or nursing, taking medication, especially blood-thinning medication, or have a medical condition.
Keep out of reach of children. Do not use if seal is broken. Store in a cool, dry place.
